card.title: Changing Basemaps
card.subtitle: Switching basemaps in the Map Editor

scenes.notes: The opening is a real timeline scene rendered into the page, not an ffmpeg overlay. It is put on screen before t0 by the prepare hook.
The map id is resolved from mapSlug rather than hard-coded.

scenes.caption: The map zooms out to fit the whole route
scenes.notes: The editor fitBounds lands on zoom 10, but the frozen OpenTopoMap tile pack covers zoom 9. Pinning zoom 9 keeps both basemaps on pinned tiles.
Hover expands the control. Do not click the toggle: Leaflet hides it while the panel is expanded.
The :visible suffix makes the count reflect the expanded panel, not the hidden label markup.
The basemap selector is scoped to the layers control because the map attribution also contains 'OpenStreetMap'. The radio's accessible name is the basemap name.

waitForMap runs the Leaflet settle routine, so the topo tile pane is stable before the hero hold. The cursor is hidden so the poster frame stays clean; the real mouse stays over the radio, which keeps the panel open. The control stays outlined because this frame is the poster: without it the thumbnail has no focal point. The poster marker is taken at the end of the hold.
Scoped like choose-topo so the attribution line cannot match.

scrollIntoView with block start puts the Shortcode panel just below the admin bar, pushing the Publish panel fully above the viewport instead of clipping it. This beat only scrolls, so a leftover synthetic pointer would land on the Shortcode text; the pointer is hidden and the real mouse is parked over the admin bar for the whole scene. The value assertion reads the real input.
content=waymark-settings-tab-tiles opens the Basemaps tab; the section heading is 'Basemaps'.

The delete control is anchored to the table's top-left corner and appears on any hover, so it always overlaps the row caption. The pointer is parked and the rows are shown without a hover state; narration carries the drag affordance. Dragging would also mutate live settings.

scenes.caption: The page scrolls back to the Basemaps heading
scenes.notes: Reset the outgoing frame so the Basemaps heading sits just below the admin bar with both reordered rows beneath it. The pointer stays parked from the preceding scene, so no hover-only control is left visible.

card.title: Changing Basemaps
card.subtitle:
The editor switch is a view change.
The Shortcode and Settings decide what visitors see.

scenes.notes: Replaces the silent outro with a typographic closing card in the timeline. The reset-view scrollTo beat is kept immediately before it.
